vintage=NREL ATB 2024 natural-gas CC + 95% CCS class, online ~2030 (ADR 0012). capex low=2300/mid=2700/high=3300 $/kW = ATB 2024 Gas-CC-95%-CCS 2030 Advanced/Moderate/Conservative class band ($2,300-3,000/kW mid class; cross-checked vs market_sim CCUS_PARAMS gas_cc_ccs_90 capex_kw=2500, NREL ATB 2024, 90% capture). fom=62 $/kW-yr = ATB CC+CCS class (unabated F-frame CC ~30 + capture-plant ~32). heat_rate=7.9 MMBtu/MWh = F-class CC 6.9 x ~1.15 capture parasitic load (NETL Cost & Performance Baseline Rev 4 2021: 12-16% NGCC penalty; ATB 95%-CCS HR class 7.5-8.2). vom=16.0 $/MWh = 2.0 base CC VOM (NREL ATB 2024) + 8.0 amine solvent/maintenance (NETL 2022 Case B31B) + 6.0 CO2 transport+storage (15 $/tCO2 NETL 2022 Gulf Coast saline x 0.399 tCO2/MWh captured = 0.95 x 0.0531 x 7.9). capture_rate=0.95 = ATB 95%-CCS class. emission_rate=0.0210 tCO2/MWh = (1-0.95) x 0.0531 tCO2/MMBtu pipeline natural gas (EPA GHG Emission Factors Hub / 40 CFR 98 Table C-1: 53.06 kg CO2/MMBtu; EIA carbon coefficient 52.91 kg/MMBtu) x 7.9 MMBtu/MWh. Clears the ADR 0012 admissibility threshold (capture>0.90 AND residual<0.050 tCO2/MWh). Fuel cost is NOT in this table: resources.py adds heat_rate x delivered gas price (data/fuel/gas_prices.csv or config.gas_price_mmbtu) minus the 45Q credit (config.ccs_45q_per_ton) at load time.

vintage=CCS capture retrofit on an EXISTING gas CC (ADR 0012); prices only the decarbonization increment - the host CC's capital is sunk and its output was already merchant, so the buyer pays capture capex/FOM plus the plant's full fuel + variable cost. capex mid=1000 $/kW ~= 65% of the mid new-build CCS increment (2700 CCS-new - ~1150 unabated ATB 2024 F-frame CC ~= 1550 $/kW), within the NPC Meeting the Dual Challenge (2019) / NETL-DOE NGCC capture-retrofit studies band (~$900-1,300/kW); low=850 (~55%), high=1300 (~70% + brownfield integration risk). life_yr=20 = conservative remaining host-plant life (the 2000s CC build wave is ~20-25 yr into a ~45-yr life) and amine capture-plant book life. fom=30 $/kW-yr = capture-plant FOM increment (ATB CC+CCS ~62 minus unabated CC ~30). heat_rate=8.1 MMBtu/MWh = F-class CC 6.9 x ~1.17 parasitic (NETL Rev 4 12-16% band, retrofit at the high end - no greenfield heat integration). vom=16.1 $/MWh = 2.0 base + 8.0 solvent (NETL 2022) + 6.1 CO2 T&S (15 $/tCO2 x 0.409 tCO2/MWh captured = 0.95 x 0.0531 x 8.1). capture_rate=0.95 same capture class as new build. emission_rate=0.0215 = (1-0.95) x 0.0531 (EPA 40 CFR 98 Table C-1) x 8.1. Clears the ADR 0012 threshold. cost_basis=capex_fixed (NOT ppa_mwh), so is_existing=False: the retrofit tranche is new/additional capture capacity and is deliberately NOT swept into the ADR 0008 additionality carve-out for existing PPA resources.
